**DEVELOPER DIARY** 

## **The Ubersreik Five by by Graeme Davis, Matthew Ward, & Mårten Stormdal**
## _**Note: the Following Pages Contain Spoilers for Various Parts of the Enemy Within Campaign. If You Intend to Play in the Campaign, Do Not Read This Article.**_
Fatshark’s best-selling Vermintide video games pit the five heroes of Ubersreik against the evil Skaven and other foes in the year 2523 IC. But where were they a decade earlier, when the events of the **Enemy Within** campaign shook the Empire to its very core? Veteran **WFRP** writer Graeme Davis and Fatshark Narrative Director Mårten Stormdal present these five heroes as they were at that time, with some suggestions on where, when, and how they might be encountered. 

While you can use these NPCs however you want, they are not recommended as replacement Player Characters or long-term companion NPCs. Their known future in the _Vermintide_ games can overshadow their actions — not to mention overshadowing the Player Characters, who are meant to be the true heroes — and the dramatic effect of a brief encounter with one of them becomes weaker if they stick around too long. The goal should be for the players to recognize the NPC, interact briefly, and be left wishing for more as the future hero continues on their own path. 

## **Victor Saltzpyre – the Witch Hunter**
Victor Saltzpyre was born the son of a blacksmith. While apprenticing for his father, a Witch Hunter Captain of the Order of the Silver Hammer recognised Victor’s potential and sought his father’s leave to train the boy. 

Just a few years ago, Victor was hunting a Vampire’s thrall, the daughter of the local Burgomeister. He discovered his prey by a warpstone seam, deep in her father’s mine. As he prepared to strike, a band of Skaven sprang from nowhere. 

After a long and gruelling struggle Victor emerged from the mine, sorely wounded but alive. He had lost an eye, but he trained constantly with his pistol as he recovered from his wounds, until he was able to shoot almost as accurately as he had done before. Soon after, Victor learned that the Burgomeister knew of the Warpstone in his mine, and had been selling it secretly both to the Skaven and to the Vampire who controlled his daughter. It had been only a matter of time before one customer sought to eliminate the other. 

After hanging the burgomeister, and those merchants he deemed accomplices in the treachery, Victor walked away a changed man. No longer able to discount the Skaven as a myth, he scoured the land for information about them and followed every sign of their activity.

## **Encountering Victor**
Victor might be encountered hunting Skaven at various points in the campaign. Here are some examples, but feel free to use him whenever you like. Although he is eleven years shy of the level of ability he displays in _Vermintide_ , he can still be a valuable ally if the Characters find themselves struggling against a group of Ratmen. 

_**Death on the Reik:**_ Skaven are trailing the Characters through the Barren Hills, and Victor might be trailing the Skaven. He could join in any battle to even the odds, though he will be very interested to know just why the Characters are wandering this blighted land in search of warpstone. He might also be encountered in Castle Wittgenstein, perhaps imprisoned in the dungeons. 

_**Power Behind the Throne:**_ Victor might appear at the inn during the event ‘Chaos Strikes by Night’ ( _Power Behind the Throne_ , page 89). If so, he has been trailing Snikkit and his band through Middenheim’s Undercity. If the odds are strongly against the Characters, Victor might be accompanied by a squad of Sewer Jacks or some other followers. 

_**The Horned Rat:**_ Since this adventure is all about Skaven, Victor might be encountered at almost any point. He might be pursuing a group of Skaven and arrive just in time to even the odds in a dangerous fight, or he might be imprisoned somewhere for the Characters to rescue. This experience could be a pivotal one in his career, sparking an obsession with Skaven that is destined to last for the rest of his life. 

_**Empire in Ruins:**_ Victor might be encountered almost anywhere, at almost any time. Witch Hunters and others are converging on Altdorf as tensions rise and the Empire seems to be in increasing peril. There are also armies in the field and Witch Hunters trying to stamp out heresy everywhere. Any Witch Hunter or similar encounter in Empire in Ruins could be an encounter with Victor. 

**Traits:** Prejudice (non-Sigmarites)

**Skills:** Animal Care 33, Charm 36, Cool 48, Dodge 40, Endurance 45, Evaluate 33, Gossip 34, Intimidate 40, Intuition 42, Leadership 36, Lore (Reikland) 33, Lore (Torture) 35, Lore (Witches) 33, Melee (Basic) 42, Melee (Fist) 42, Perception 42, Ranged (Pistol) 38, Ride (Horse) 39, Trade (Blacksmith) 34

**Talents:** Ambidextrous, Commanding Presence, Coolheaded, Dual Wielder, Marksman, Menacing, Read/Write, Resolute, Savvy, Seasoned Traveller, Shadow, Very Strong

**Trappings:** Leather jack; silvered sword; pistol with powder and shot; instruments of torture; hat; rope; riding horse with saddle and tack.

She was partly driven by a desire to improve her skills, and when she was spotted and challenged this was the reason she gave. But it was not the only reason, for she was born with an insatiable curiosity about everyone, everything, and everywhere, which all too often overrode her more cautious instincts. 

When she was chosen to train as a Ghost Strider, the decision seemed like a natural recognition of her abilities, but that was not the only reason. Her mixture of stealth and curiosity had irritated some and embarrassed others, and there were many in Athel Loren who had reason to want her sent away on long, solitary patrols far from home. This suited Kerillian as much as it suited them, and eventually she could not resist the temptation to venture out of the forest and into the worlds of Humans, Dwarfs, and Halflings. 

## **Encountering Kerillian**
Kerillian can be encountered almost anywhere, especially in wooded areas. She might even find the Characters interesting, and decide to follow them for a while. While she is happy to help a struggling party with a few arrows from cover, she is not particularly interested in making the party’s acquaintance — unless they turn out to be particularly interesting — and she will usually avoid contact as much as she can. 

## **Kerillian – Ghost Strider (Silver 5)**
_**Enemy in Shadows:**_ Kerillian might be encountered on the road to Bögenhafen, travelling through the forest hunting Mutants and others for fun. If the Characters need help in ‘Mistaken Identity,’ she could shoot a few arrows from cover to help even the odds. She won’t stick around to chat, though, and the Characters can only hope to catch a glimpse of her back retreating into the forest. If they decide to follow her, she may resent their nosiness. 

_Note: The Ghost Strider Career can be found in Archives of the Empire, Volume 1 (page 88)._

## **Markus Kruber – the Soldier**
Bored with life on his family’s farm outside Ubersreik, young Markus Kruber joined the Grunburg militia and rose quickly through the ranks before a disagreement with an inept officer resulted in a posting to distant Ostland, but it turned out to suit Kruber perfectly. 

Rising to command of the 8th Ostland Swordsmen, Markus drilled his troops to perfection. His leadership inspired confidence and loyalty, and his unit distinguished itself in several battles, breaking Greenskin lines, repulsing marauding Beastmen, and hacking down berserk Northlanders. 

## **Encountering Markus**
At the time when the campaign takes place, Markus is still in command of the 8th Ostland Swordsmen. He is devoted to his men and to his duty, but will not be unfriendly toward the Characters unless they cross him. 

_**The Horned Rat:**_ While the Characters are at the Middenland side of the Picket, the Ostland commander comes to visit. Markus and his troops could be among his escort. 

_**Empire in Ruins:**_ Troops are moving all over the Empire as tensions rise and various factions make their plays for power. The Characters could encounter Markus in the capital as part of a beefed-up Ostland electoral force, or in the countryside leading his unit on some mission.

## **Developer Diary**
## **Bardin Goreksson**
Bardin is a Karak Ranger in the Grey Mountains, keeping the holds of Karak Ziflin and Karak Norn safe from attack. On one patrol he came across an abandoned mine entrance. The mine was clearly Dwarfen in origin but, despite the decades he had spent ranging across the Grey Mountains, it was not one Bardin knew of. The mine entrance must have been hidden until recently, perhaps revealed by a rock slide. 

Without a moment’s thought, Goreksson entered. As he had expected, the mine was long since exhausted of ore. Further in, the Ranger came across something of interest: four Dwarfen bodies clothed in the rotten rags of stout traveling clothes, lying beside a mound of long-dead rats and the unmistakable corpse of a Ratman. In its clawed, withered hands was a small scrap of parchment, with Dwarf runes clearly visible upon it. 

Another piece of the same parchment was in the backpack of one of the dead Dwarfs. Bardin put the parts together and discovered, to his astonishment, that he had an ancient map to Karak Zorn, the fabled lost hold of the Worlds Edge Mountains. The map was of limited use though, as it was cunningly encoded using an ancient cipher that Bardin found impenetrable. Nonetheless, Bardin is determined to find the lost hold, and to make his name live throughout history.

## **Encountering Bardin**
While the Characters are battling the Purple Hand and its allies, Bardin is wandering the mountains looking for more clues to the location of Karak Zorn. 

_**Power Behind the Throne:**_ Bardin might be encountered in Middenheim, having come to the city to consult Dwarf loremasters there. He will take the opportunity to enjoy the Carnival while he is in the city. 

_**The Horned Rat:**_ Following some clue from Middenheim’s Dwarf loremasters, Bardin might head into the Middle Mountains at the same time as the Characters, searching the remains of Karaz Ghumzul for lost records that mention Karak Zorn. He could be encountered in the mountains or as a prisoner of the Skaven. 

_**Empire in Ruins:**_ The Characters venture into the World’s Edge Mountains during this adventure, and Bardin might be encountered there. He could be resting or seeking information at Karak Angazhar, or he might be encountered further into the mountains. While the Characters should undertake the various trials without help, Bardin might arrive at the shrine of Sigmar by chance just as the Characters need some help against the Daemons that threaten to break through there.

## **Sienna Fuegonasus**
Sienna was born in Estalia, but her childhood was cut short by the emergence of spontaneous magical powers. It was whispered that the girl was a witch, and her parents sent her away before the neighbours could take matters into her own hands. She travelled to the Empire with a merchant caravan, heading for Altdorf with its famed colleges of magic. 

She was admitted to the College of the Bright Order and quickly mastered the Lore of Fire. Equally quickly, though, it became clear that her strong will and lack of patience did not suit her for the academic life. Instead, she became addicted to the surge of Aqshy passing through her body. Ignoring all warnings, Sienna threw herself into her addiction, and has never looked back since. 

Her recklessness and fierce temper worried her fellow Bright Wizards as she sought to master the greatest and most dangerous challenges. She always strove to create the highest walls of flame and the hottest fireballs, and to summon the most impressive conflagrations. Eventually she became too dangerous — though she would say that the College had nothing left to teach her except boredom — and she left to test her powers against the perils of the outside world. 

## **Encountering Sienna**
Sienna may be encountered in Altdorf at any time, perhaps in the final days of her residence at the Bright College, or almost anywhere else as she travels across the Empire to test her powers in the outside world. Given her temper and impatience, the Characters may find themselves needing to rescue some hapless NPC from her wrath, or to deal with a fire that she has started through boredom, mischief, or anger.

They might also meet her on the road or river at any time, either as an unexpected source of help in a desperate battle or as the culprit behind a burning boat, coach, or building after someone annoys her. 

_**Power Behind the Throne:**_ Sienna might travel to Middenheim to see whether the fierce Ulricans of the north are less po-faced than her instructors in Altdorf. Not knowing that her visit coincides with the annual Carnival and the imposition of a tax on Wizards, she will find her patience tested to the limit and trouble with the city’s authorities seems almost inevitable. 

_**The Horned Rat:**_ Looking for adventure or combat experience, Sienna might make her way through the Middle Mountains. Combat spellcasters are always welcome at the Picket, especially since years and decades of quiet from Brass Keep has led distant commanders to draw down the forces posted there. Alternatively, her travels in the mountains might include her first encounter with the Skaven, setting her future course…. 

_**Empire in Ruins:**_ Soldiers, spellcasters, and others are converging on Altdorf as political and religious tensions rise, and Sienna could well be among them. She might have joined some faction temporarily, or she might be travelling on her own account, drawn by the promise of action. Alternatively, she might be encountered wandering the mountains alone, hunting Greenskins and other foes for sport. 

## **What About Ubersreik?**
Since the group comes together in Ubersreik in 2523 for the events of _Warhammer: End Times — Vermintide_ , you might want to use their younger selves in the **WFRP Starter Set** or the **Ubersreik Adventures** series. Here are a few suggestions: we are sure you can think of more. Remember, though, that in 2512, they have not even met each other. 

_**Again, these notes include spoilers for various adventures. Do not read any more if you intend to play in any of them.**_ 

## **Victor**
_**WFRP Starter Set:**_ Victor might be passing through Ubersreik at the same time as the Characters, either dropping off a prisoner or rubbing the Watch up the wrong way. He might be at the court in ‘Making the Rounds’, prosecuting the case that is heard before the Characters face the judge. Alternatively you might adapt Part 5, ‘The Prisoner and the Warden’, so that Victor is hunting a Mutant or low-level cultist. 

_**Ubersreik Adventures:**_ Victor might be one of the strangers stalking Cordelia in ‘Bait and Witch’. He might be alone, or accompanied by a Bounty Hunter or a junior Witch Hunter. 

## **Developer Diary**
_**Ubersreik Adventures II:**_ The highway robberies in ‘Fishrook Returns’ take place on lonely road as they wind through the forest, which is exactly where Kerillian feels most at home. It is quite possible that she might stumble across a robbery in progress, or be moved by curiosity to follow the Characters as they try to deal with the situation. If her presence it detected, it can provide a distraction that increases the challenge of the adventure. 

## **Markus**
_**WFRP Starter Set:**_ The short adventure ‘Red Moon Burning’ might allow the Characters to encounter Markus, who is on leave and visiting an old comrade. If so, Lohner was a member of the 8th Ostland Swordsmen before joining the Grudgebringers. 

## **Bardin**
_**WFRP Starter Set:**_ Bardin might become involved in the short adventure ‘The Riddle of Silver’, perhaps following up leads at Migdhal Agril in the hope of finding more information about Karak Zorn. If the Characters venture into Dawihafen in the course of another adventure, Bardin might be there seeking the advice of a learned Dwarf Loremaster, and perhaps paying the Loremaster back by working as a bodyguard temporarily, or by undertaking a few errands. 

## **Sienna**
_**WFRP Starter Set:**_ Sienna could very easily be caught up in the riot at the start of ‘Making the Rounds’. She is unlikely to accept servitude in the Watch, though, so she may escape and leave town or be shipped off to face imprisonment or some other punishment. Alternatively, the event ‘Fire!’ (page 19) might be due to one of Sienna’s outbursts of temper — or she might use her control of fire and her limited fire resistance to rescue those trapped in the burning building. 

_**Ubersreik Adventures:**_ Kerillian might be staying at Bridge House during the events of ‘The Guilty Party’. Although she does not try to become involved, her impatience and short temper may get the better of her. 

## **Kerillian**
_**Ubersreik Adventures:**_ Kerillian might be staying at Bridge House during the events of ‘The Guilty Party’, or she might be encountered at some other place along the way. Although she cares little for Human rivalries, she might not be able to avoid being caught up in events, and might find herself on the same side as the Characters, or opposed to them, or otherwise involved.
